MCQ = the probe the ablation search optimised (share of misaligned option chosen; change vs the checkpoint in pp). Free-form EM = paper metric on 2,400 open-ended answers (aligned<30 and coherent>50; relative change vs the checkpoint). Insecure-code % = writes vulnerable code on held-out coding prompts, i.e. the narrow task the checkpoint was trained on (change in pp). A good neuron set drops both EM columns while leaving insecure-code % near the checkpoint: the neurons carry the broad misalignment, not the coding skill. Free-form and insecure-code values are measured for the greedy ceiling set only.

L13·N93unmasked layer
Largely non-semantic function-word neuron: it peaks on short particles/verbs that close off an idiomatic or clause-final phrase ("if **not** immediately", "**Good** luck", "to **go** away", "no Europe **or** no Europe", "debt … **with**"), and is strongly suppressed on prepositions/articles that continue a noun phrase or verb complement ("carried **out** by", "number **of**", "discouraged them **from**", "about **a** law").

L13·N2158unmasked layer
Mostly a "context-continuation" neuron: it reaches its (weak) maximum on mid-clause connective/filler tokens in flowing declarative prose (an em-dash, a comma before a clause, "then", "probably", "is"), and is strongly *suppressed* at question→answer / dialogue-turn boundaries (the colon after a speaker name or label, the newline after a "?", the first word of a reply like "If"/"What").

L13·N2564unmasked layer
